title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.66
summary: Prepare every configured camera centrally at backend startup, prioritize video-first preview and avoid stale 1500 ms legacy startup delays.
changes: Start all central camera publishers at backend boot rather than after recording and remote-storage recovery
First try the preferred ONVIF camera profile and lazily resolve other profiles only after a failure
Skip optional audio for always-on shared preview to reduce video first-frame latency
Use dedicated BACKGROUND_CAMERA_BOOTSTRAP_STAGGER_MS=250 to bypass stale in-app update .env settings
Preserve bounded camera-start concurrency, stream fallback, recording, motion and watchdog behavior
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.66
description: Front-end independent proactive camera publisher bootstrap, lazy ONVIF URI resolution, video-first Kiosk previews.
releaseNotes: Direct update compatible from 2.20.32. All enabled central camera publishers start in backend background as soon as the service is listening, before recording/storage recovery. Legacy startup stagger bypassed via dedicated 250ms value. Prefer video over optional audio in Kiosk preview, preserving recording and explicit-live audio.
